name: prompt-translator
description: Translate prompts before Claude Code using your own OpenAI-compatible API.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Complete OpenAI-compatible chat/completions URL. Change this when using another provider.

model.title: Translation model
model.description: Model ID accepted by your translation API.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Saved in secure storage. Alternatively use TRANSLATOR_API_KEY in the environment or plugin .env.

language.title: Target language
language.description: en: English; jp: Japanese; cn: Simplified Chinese; fr: French. Controls prompt translation and replies.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: Use low for the default GLM model. Choose default to omit this field for APIs that do not support it.
